_comment: Hero quests (PLAN.md M5 step 22). The hero offers `offers` quests at a time, new ones every `refreshHours` game hours. A quest takes the road there and back (`distance` hexes each way at the hero's speed; for ruins, the way to the site) plus `hours` on the spot; the hero then comes home with `xp` (times its heroXp) or, with chance `risk`, wounded. ambush: the next horde from the front sets out `delayHours` later, and hates the more for it (horde.json hatred); the more that horde already hates, the riskier the ambush (`hatredRisk` x its hatred added to `risk`, at most `maxRisk`) and the more XP it gives (x 1 + `hatredXp` x its hatred). scout: a full report on the next horde from the front. caravan: `resources` (times 1 + `perLevel` x (level - 1)) to the hero's village. hoard: a piece of gear the hero doesn't have. ruins: the hero searches an unguarded ancient site. hunt and tribute: like caravan, `resources` home. shrine: XP only. Army quests (`army`): offered instead while the hero leads an army standing in the field (`offers` of them at a time, one quest at a time): taking one raises its place `minDistance`-`maxDistance` hexes from the army (warband: a camp, warlord: a lair, barrow: a guarded ancient site, hard to take) held by `units` + `unitsPerLevel` x the hero's level of a front's troops, and the army marches on it. Cleared (or searched) within `lastsHours`, it gives the hero `xp` and its `resources` (times 1 + `perLevel` x (level - 1)) ride home with the army; the barrow gives a hard ruin's finds instead. Not done in time, the place is gone.

ambush.name: Ambush the horde's road
ambush.description: Fell trees across the road and burn the fords: the next horde from the {front} sets out later.

scout.name: Ride beyond the border
scout.description: Count the next horde from the {front} with your own eyes: its size, its troops and its stance.

caravan.name: Find the lost caravan
caravan.description: A merchant's train went missing in the woods. Bring back what is left of it.

hoard.name: The smith's hoard
hoard.description: An old smith buried his best work under his hearth before the hordes came. Dig it up.

ruins.name: Search the ruins
ruins.description: Search the {site} in person: nothing guards it now.

hunt.name: Hunt the great boar
hunt.description: A boar the size of an ox tramples the fields. Bring it down and feast the village.

tribute.name: Collect the hill clans' tribute
tribute.description: The hill clans owe tribute since the last horde was turned back. Ride out and bring it home.

shrine.name: Pilgrimage to Perun's oak
shrine.description: Keep vigil a night and a day under the thunder god's oak, and come back wiser.

warband.name: Break the raiders' warband
warband.description: Raiders gather in the wilds to fall on your roads. Take the army and scatter them before they strike.

warlord.name: Hunt down the Nav warlord
warlord.description: A warlord of Nav has made a den in the borderland. Lead the army against him and his guard.

barrow.name: Storm the haunted barrow
barrow.description: The dead walk around a chieftain's barrow, and his grave goods lie within. Break their ring and search it.
